title: 50 Year Interviews
description: A documentary series produced for ZIGZAG, capturing 50 years of stories from the people who shaped South African surf culture.

title: Ark of Hope
description: A short documentary exploring how a 130-year-old Cape Flats rugby club transforms young lives through brotherhood, discipline, and hope.

title: Hope
description: A hero film for Khanyisa — an organisation that gives families with children of differing ability a place to belong. We spent time with the incredible people who make it what it is, and let their stories do the talking.

title: Try Something New Today Campaign
description: A social campaign for Saint & Summer built around one simple idea: "Try Something New Today." An expression of a creative soul finding genuine happiness through making things.

title: Confidence Campaign
description: A showcase of stills from the Confidence shoot for Kingsley Heath — speaking to the inner confidence the brand carries and the people who embody it.

title: All-Hands Campaign
description: Some work we did for Coca-Cola ahead of their All-Hands Conference that was hosted in Cape Town during November 2025. Whilst we are unable to share any work from the final asset, here are some shot not included in the edit.

title: Seeing Sound.
description: Seeing Sound is a new original series by Paper Plane Creative that dives into the heart of music creation. Each episode features intimate conversations with artists and their producers as they unpack the journey behind a single track - followed by a stripped-back acoustic performance that brings the story to life. This is where visual meets sound, and storytelling takes centre stage. This first episode's guest interviews Andrew Sutton and his producer Dale James Young over their song 'Rosie'.
